title: "Stage 01 — Data Loading"
author: "Hemanth Sai Charagundla"
output: html_document
---------------------

## 1. Purpose

This stage loads the raw CPC18 dataset into R without modifying the original source file.

The dataset is loaded as an in-memory working object, and its column names are standardized for subsequent analysis.

## 2. Load Required Packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "..")

library(data.table)
library(janitor)
```

## 3. Load Dataset

```{r data-loading, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("R/01_data_loading.R")
```

## 4. Loading Confirmation

The CPC18 raw dataset was successfully loaded.

* **CPC18:** 694,500 rows × 30 columns

The original raw CSV file remains unchanged. Data profiling and quality assessment are performed separately in the subsequent stages.
